name: Ibaraki (Ibaraki, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Ibaraki town emblem in white: a stylised bird with outstretched wings above a ring with a cross.
history: Municipal flag of Ibaraki, a town in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 14 May 1956.

features.role: Ibaraki town emblem — a stylised bird with outstretched wings above a ring with a cross
